about: LABS-1.065 coordinator allocation (benchmark/e2/spec/coverage-matrix.md, with the adjustments recorded in docs/stage-e/stage-e2-labs-1065-review.md). Kept from authors: the `targets` mapping (slot -> DI) is merged into the questions by the coordinator after authoring; authors see only the boundary condition.

targeted: a frame asked about itself, the frame being visible in the world (mark the convention)
two distinct frames where no frame-transform involving either frame is visible at the question's as_of (another transform becomes visible only later)
a search truncated by `limit` whose route already reached contains a transform disputed by an accepted denial
probes: the rotation as roll, pitch and yaw
the distance between two positioned things

targeted: a position stated under an alias of the thing (the same-as link is accepted), asked with the canonical name
a position derived through a chain whose position statement is disputed by an accepted denial
a position derived through a chain whose position statement is disputed for the question's perspective only (another perspective sees no dispute)
`where` with two candidates of which one has no position comparable with the other, so not every pair was compared (judgement label)
probes: a point fixed in a frame anchored to a thing that moved
a position between two stated poses (interpolation)
the root of a frame hierarchy
a part's position given only its assembly's
holds() asked for one particular position
the interval over which a derived position holds

targeted: a measurement recorded against an alias of the bearer (same-as accepted), asked by the canonical name
two measurements compared where the measured content of one is denied by an accepted denial
measurements asked with `t` where an accepted denial of a measured content covers t
two explicit instantaneous measurements at the same instant, compared
measurement_calibration where the activity's start is an uncertain window inside which the certificate's validity ends
a stated (not measured) quality value given in a non-SI unit, as listed by measurements
probes: pass or fail against a specification
the best estimate from several measurements
the derivation of a derived quantity
comparison of measurements at disjoint times of a quantity declared constant

targeted: a causal claim made about an event description that no describes link connects to any occurrence
a causal claim about a description whose describes link is denied by an accepted denial
a cause lifted through describes links, with the links required as evidence
an effect claim whose outcome moves from UNKNOWN to held (no accepted prior state)
an effect claim whose outcome becomes held some time after the event ends (delayed effect)
a causal or effect claim whose attestation carries a valid interval that excludes the question's t (timeless claim, SD-CAU-7)
probes: a causal chain of two or more steps
would the state hold if the event had not happened
the strength or mechanism of a cause
`alternatives` listing unaccepted initiating claims in explain (accept absent)

targeted: two instantaneous events whose possible instants share one moment (touching windows), ordered with before
a description with two usable accounts giving different times, ordered against another event
an instantaneous event at the very instant another, durative event starts, ordered with before
probes: which preconditions held when a step started
which expected step did not happen

targeted: holds asked for a classification without its optional context, where the recorded classification has a context
holds asked for a content with a mandatory role missing
value_at asked for the holders of an exclusive office whose two accepted appointments conflict
a calibration-then-certificate plan where the measuring activity's start is an uncertain window inside which a certificate lapses and another begins
an explanation plan where one initiating claim is accepted and another is unreviewed
probes: a free question needing the system to compose its own plan (not callable)
where was the part whose measurement failed
the derivation record of a chained answer
`constraint_support` on a facts_about entry disputed under an exclusive office (accept absent)
